direction.composition_strategy: Create a composition where lush natural foliage dominates, presenting a panoramic view of a botanical garden from a low angle, emphasizing the height and density of the foliage. Use the central band of the image to highlight the most vibrant and varied foliage, while the edges of the frame are used for quieter, more subtle elements that still contribute to the cohesive botanical garden atmosphere.
direction.focal_strategy: Place the focal point on a particularly vibrant and lush section of the botanical garden, featuring a variety of leaf textures and colors. This focal area should capture the essence of the botanical garden, drawing the eye with its rich green hues and elegant cream accents.
direction.depth_strategy: Achieve a sense of depth by layering foliage from the foreground to the background, with the most detailed and vibrant foliage in the foreground and a softer, more blurred foliage in the background, creating an immersive natural landscape.
direction.border_or_perimeter_strategy: The perimeter of the image will be treated with a subtle blend of foliage edges, ensuring that the botanical garden atmosphere is consistent throughout the entire frame, with no abrupt transitions or empty spaces.
direction.title_safe_region_strategy: Create a safe-space for the title by positioning a slightly lighter area of foliage along the top third of the image, ensuring that the text will be clearly visible against the green background.
direction.programme_safe_region_strategy: Designate a safe-space for the programme information by incorporating a subtle, uniform area near the bottom of the image, ensuring it contrasts well with the green foliage while maintaining the botanical garden aesthetic.

direction.composition_strategy: Create a composition featuring a frontal view of dense foliage, with a strong focus on a left-side cluster of leaves and stems. The foliage will spill outwards towards the right, creating an asymmetrical balance. Use receding planes to imply depth, with the most detailed and vibrant foliage in the foreground gradually softening towards the background. The overall shape aims for a dynamic, asymmetric cluster within the frame.
direction.focal_strategy: Position the focal point on the upper-left cluster of foliage, highlighting intricate leaf details, subtle colour variations and delicate textures. This area should draw the eye with its vibrant green hues and carefully crafted highlights, contrasting slightly with the softer, more muted tones of the surrounding foliage.
direction.depth_strategy: Achieve a sense of depth through a receding plane strategy. Foreground foliage will be highly detailed and sharply focused, while subsequent layers will become progressively softer and more blurred, creating an illusion of depth and distance within the botanical garden setting.
direction.border_or_perimeter_strategy: The perimeter of the image will be open, allowing the foliage to visually 'breathe' and extend beyond the boundaries of the frame, enhancing the feeling of an immersive natural environment. Avoid hard edges or abrupt transitions; instead, allow the foliage to subtly fade or blur towards the edges.
direction.title_safe_region_strategy: Create a clear, uncluttered title safe area along the top third of the image, utilizing a lighter tonal variation within the foliage. This will ensure legibility of any overlaid text without disrupting the botanical garden atmosphere.
direction.programme_safe_region_strategy: Designate a programme safe-space along the bottom right edge of the image, employing a subtle shift in tonal value or texture within the foliage to differentiate it from the primary background. Maintain the overall botanical theme while providing a clear contrast for overlaid information.

direction.composition_strategy: A central-focal composition with an oblique viewpoint, emphasizing a right-centric focus to create a sense of dynamic tension.

direction.depth_strategy: The shallow depth plan is used to keep the scene from appearing overly cluttered, maintaining a clean and focused visual experience.
direction.border_or_perimeter_strategy: The open perimeter plan ensures that the scene appears unconstrained and allows for a natural flow of visual elements.
direction.title_safe_region_strategy: The title-safe region is positioned at the upper part of the frame to avoid overlapping with the main focal point, ensuring readability.
direction.programme_safe_region_strategy: The programme-safe region is strategically placed at the lower part of the frame, ensuring that it does not interfere with the primary visual elements of the scene.
